Title: MOXIEBEAT - Moxiebeat (12")
Description:
For fans of: Ruptures, Cassilis and The Catalyst.

This one-sided 5-song vinyl is stunning, aurally and optically. This was voted in my top 10 EPs of 2013.

Amazing double-sided picdisc vinyl /500. 5 tracks.

Check them out live, here:
http://openmindsaturatedbrain.blogspot.ca/2013/12/edhochuli-moxiebeat-creeper-faye-raegan.html

Title: MOURNING CLOAK - No Visible Light (12")
Description:
For fans of: Northless, Castle and Fall Of Efrafa.

North Carolina's MOURNING CLOAK drop three massive tracks of doomy, sludgy post-hardcore/metal in the vein of Light Bearer, Northless and Monuments Collapse.

Black vinyl 12" with a beautifully embossed cover. 3 songs.

Listen here:
https://mourningcloaknc.bandcamp.com/

Title: HASHCUT - Please Do It Yourself (12")
Description:
For fans of: Old Man Gloom, Spires and Marnost.

From France, Hashcut play sludgy hardcore with massive heaviness and atmospherics. This is some brutal shit.

White 12" vinyl with 2-sided lyric sheet that becomes a tear and puzzle poster. 6 songs.

Listen here:
https://hashcut.bandcamp.com/album/please-do-it-yourself
